objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Win the race to run your own command and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The script is written, then checked, then removed; other requests run it in between.
Read about time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race conditions.

steps.title: Find the shared file
steps.prompt: Which script file does the application write and then run?

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which parameter carries the name written into it? (name)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: What class of vulnerability is this? (acronym accepted)

answer: time of check time of use
